description: Research hypotheses / knowledge-gap templates derived from encounters or missing packs.

gap_checks.title: Missing exam template for complaint
gap_checks.hypothesis_template: Does adding a Bates-aligned exam pack for {complaint_code} improve documentation completeness?

gap_checks.title: Missing reasoning rule pack
gap_checks.hypothesis_template: Can specialty-neutral pattern rules for {complaint_code} be seeded from guideline summaries without disease extraction from Bates?

gap_checks.title: Low pattern confidence after substantial history
gap_checks.hypothesis_template: Which additional history/exam items most lift confidence for {complaint_code} encounters with max confidence < 0.45?

gap_checks.title: Emergency stop-rule triggered
gap_checks.hypothesis_template: What is the time-to-escalation distribution when stop-rules fire for {complaint_code}?

question_bank.title: Pain region vs final pathway concordance
question_bank.prompt: Among CI abdominal pain encounters, how often does Q000042 region match the eventual investigation/procedure pathway?

question_bank.title: Murphy sign and ultrasound yield
question_bank.prompt: What is the association between documented Murphy sign and biliary ultrasound positive flags in interpretation packs?
